faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's consultation for sexual wellness treatments?
faqs.answer: Yes. All P-Shot, PT-141, and hormone treatments require a medical consultation. You will speak privately with our licensed medical doctor, who reviews your health before prescribing a custom plan if treatment is appropriate.

faqs.question: What does the doctor-guided intimacy program include?
faqs.answer: Your program includes a private 1-on-1 consultation with a board-certified doctor, baseline bloodwork, your customized in-office treatment with prescription numbing, and ongoing follow-up check-ins.

faqs.question: Are P-Shot treatments painful?
faqs.answer: Discomfort varies. We apply prescription numbing cream before treatment, and your provider will explain what to expect. Many patients return to normal activities the same day, but recovery varies.

faqs.question: When might I notice any changes from sexual wellness treatment?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary by person and by treatment, and some people notice no change. Your provider will review your progress and adjust the plan. Results vary and are not guaranteed.

faqs.question: Are these treatments private and confidential?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your privacy is a priority. All consultations and treatments take place in private rooms in our discreet St. Petersburg clinic.

faqs.question: How do I get started with sexual wellness care?
faqs.answer: Getting started is simple! Call our clinic today at (727) 476-8966 or click 'Book Your Doctor Consultation' online. Our doctor will answer all your questions in complete confidence and start your plan.
